item.description:
In-person campus series

Futuready Builders Lab

AI now writes most of the code. It finds its own bugs, fixes them and even tests its own security. So what will make you valuable in 2031?

Futuready Builders Lab is a series of 2-hour, hands-on bootcamps at zero cost that answers that question on your campus. No long lectures. Phones out, squads up, learn and build for the future.

01

Hands-on, not a lecture

Live polls, games and a leaderboard on your phone, all session long.

02

Built for the AI era

Real AI tools, real code, real bugs. Skills that hold when AI does the typing.

03

A framework for life

Ready: five skills you can use whenever the next big technology arrives.

When AI writes all the code, builders will have new roles. Learn to find yours.

title: Futuready Builders Lab
